package.name: g1_sim
package.description:
MuJoCo simulator of the Unitree G1 in an industrial warehouse, used as the plant for the A*+MPC stack: in Gazebo the G1 would have no source of motion without writing one from scratch.
In kinematic mode (default) the base is integrated from /cmd_vel with x_{k+1} = x_k + (vx cos(yaw) - vy sin(yaw)) dt y_{k+1} = y_k + (vx sin(yaw) + vy cos(yaw)) dt yaw_{k+1} = yaw_k + wz dt which is exactly the holonomic SE(2) model the MPC optimises over: the model/plant mismatch is nil, so the optimization experiments measure the solver and not the gait.
Derived from the teaching material of the CIHR laboratory (policypilot package), reduced to the simulation part only: Nav2, slam_toolbox and maps are not needed because this stack plans without a prior map.
